name: Voffo.ai
tagline: AI image and video studio: create images and videos from text and references
description: Voffo.ai is an AI image and video studio that creates images and videos from text prompts and reference images. Video models include Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0, Wan 3.0, Vidu Q4 and MiniMax H3; image models include GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2, Seedream 5.0 and Flux 3 Klein. You can try 2 free images a day without signing in, and use free in-browser video tools (Reframe, Trimmer, Video Text). Paid monthly plans with credits start at $9.
